source_policy: Definition-level references support the mathematical vocabulary. All stories and worked quantities are original constructed teaching scenarios, not measurements or historical events. Historical priority and notation claims require separate claim-level evidence before publication.
purpose: Read area scale, orientation reversal and collapse from one signed number.
meaning: For a real 2 by 2 matrix, ad-bc is the determinant. Its magnitude is the area of the transformed unit square. The sign records orientation; zero identifies collapse and absence of a unique inverse.

signature.inverseExists: true exactly when the computed determinant is nonzero

conditions: Use a real square 2 by 2 matrix with fixed entry order.
Geometric area is the absolute determinant, not negative material.
The sign records preservation or reversal of ordered-axis orientation.
Zero determinant is valid and means collapse and no unique inverse.
definition.domain_notes: This bounded real 2 by 2 specimen uses coefficients in [-3,3] and a unit-square reference. It does not calculate higher-dimensional determinants, arbitrary-region areas or a matrix inverse. The general determinant concept is broader.
